links.comparator_used: Single LLM response per query (without self-consistency)
links.outcome: F1 for irAE extraction in retrospective evaluation
links.quote: Retrospectively, the system achieved a macro-averaged F<sub>1</sub> of 0.92 for current-event detection and 0.66 for multi-class severity grading; self-consistency improved F<sub>1</sub> by 0.14.

links.comparator_used: Manual annotation by clinical trial staff without agentic assistance
links.outcome: Annotation time, complete-match accuracy and interannotator agreement in randomized crossover study
links.effect: Annotation time reduced by 2.71 min (P < 0.001); complete-match accuracy OR 1.45 (95% CI 1.01-2.08; P = 0.045); Krippendorff's α from 0.22-0.51 to 0.82-0.85
links.quote: In a randomized crossover study of clinical trial staff, agentic assistance reduced annotation time by 2.71 min (P < 0.001), increased complete-match accuracy (odds ratio 1.45; 95% confidence interval 1.01-2.08; P = 0.045) and improved interannotator agreement (Krippendorff's α from 0.22-0.51 to 0.82-0.85).

design_hint: AI assistance in clinical workflow / human verification
